app.title: Show HN: Real-time Solar System with 526k asteroids and all tracked satellites
app.author: wanick
app.description: A client‑side JavaScript application that renders a 3D model of the Solar System with real‑time data on asteroids and satellites, powered by Three.js and a public space‑tracking API.
proposed_tests: Clone repo and run `npm install` to build the project.
Serve the app locally with `npm start` and verify the 3D scene loads without errors.
Automate a headless browser test to capture a screenshot of the scene and compare against a baseline image.
Measure the initial load time and the FPS during idle and while scrolling the scene.
Run a simple fetch against the public API used for asteroids and confirm the data shape matches the documentation.
